description: Searches Trikaal Vaani's classical Jyotish library by meaning, in Hindi, English or Hinglish — about 90,000 shlokas, rules and remedies from Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Phaladeepika, Saravali, Jataka Parijata, Brihat Samhita, Jataka Tattva, Atharvaveda with Kaushika Sutra, Rigveda, the Upanishads and more. Returns up to 5 references, each with granth, chapter and shloka number and a one- or two-line summary. Full shloka text and translations are not returned.

granth.description: Optional: limit to one granth, e.g. bphs, phaladipika, saravali, atharvaveda

query.description: Topic or question, e.g. 'seventh lord in the twelfth house', 'Shani shanti daan', 'शादी में देरी'

name: shastra_search
title: Shastra search (classical Jyotish library references)
